name: Coast Mountains

geo.extent: Mainland BC coast from the Fraser River to the Alaska Panhandle

description: The Western System ranges that rise directly from the fjorded Pacific coast of mainland British Columbia; glaciated, very wet on the windward side and the barrier that separates the mild, rainy coast from the drier interior. Mount Waddington (4,016 m) is the highest summit wholly in British Columbia.

attributes.ecozone_named_in_source: Pacific Maritime (mountains, minor coastal plains; coastal evergreen forest; mild temperate, very wet to cold alpine)
